title: Arrow keys nudge everything you picked
goal: With several layers picked, the arrow keys do nothing at all. They should nudge every picked layer by one point (ten with Shift held), together, in one undo step, the same way dragging them on the picture now moves them together.
notes:
CanvasView keyDown arrow branch requires selectedLayerID, which is nil whenever multiSelectedLayerIDs is non-empty, so the press falls through to nothing. Reuse PhotonzDocument.multiLayerDrag(moving:) + EditorState.commitCanvasOrigins, the pair the canvas multi-drag added on 2026-09-03: build the plan, offset its bounds by the nudge, commit the origins. Noticed while building the canvas multi-drag.

Shipped: Sources/PhotonzCore/MultiLayerDrag.swift (origins(offsetBy:)), Sources/Photonz/CanvasView.swift (keyDown multi branch), Sources/Photonz/EditorState.swift (commitCanvasOrigins drops a stale marquee). Walk: Scripts/playtest/nudge-selection-walk.json. Audit: queue/audits/2026-09-03-arrow-keys-nudge.json.
acceptance: An arrow key with two or more layers picked moves every one of them by one point
Shift and an arrow moves every picked layer by ten points
One undo puts all of them back in one step
A locked picked layer stays where it is

log.note: Adversarial pass before building: the idea holds up. Arrow keys have no other meaning on the canvas with layers picked, the plan multiLayerDrag builds already leaves out locked layers and pieces inside a picked group, and reusing it means a nudge and a drag can never disagree about what moves. Shortest version: one new pure function (a distance instead of a destination) plus one branch in the canvas.

Reproduced first, on the real app: Scripts/playtest/nudge-selection-walk.json. One layer picked, right arrow moved it 120 -> 121. Two picked, right arrow and shift-down both did nothing, and the two undos afterwards unwound the DRAWING, proving no history entry was made at all.

Built it. PhotonzCore: MultiLayerDrag.origins(offsetBy:) with four tests written first (every member travels the nudge, shift is ten, a locked picked layer is left out, zero moves nobody). CanvasView keyDown: a multi branch ahead of the single-layer one, on pickedLayerIDs.count > 1, committing through onMoveSelectionCommit so the whole move is one undo step.

Adversarial pass on the built thing found a real flaw: a selection made by SWEEPING a band left that band on screen after a nudge, outlining where the layers used to be. A drag never showed it because its first live update drops the band. Fixed in EditorState.commitCanvasOrigins so both paths clear it, and re-photographed.

Verified on the real app (probe, Screen Recording granted): two picked + right arrow moves both by 1 and leaves the third alone; shift-down moves both by 10; one undo takes the 10 back in one step; a swept selection of three nudges all three and drops the band. Locked layers are covered by core tests only, since the playtest harness cannot lock a layer. Scripts/test.sh: 2346 tests green.
CanvasView and EditorState are shared files, as the canvas multi-drag this completes already was, so Current and Next both get it. No flag.

Arrow keys now move a whole multi-selection: 1pt a press, 10 with Shift, one undo step. PhotonzCore MultiLayerDrag.origins(offsetBy:) (tests first), a multi branch in CanvasView.keyDown, and commitCanvasOrigins now drops the sweep band a nudge used to leave behind. Reproduced then verified on the probe app (Scripts/playtest/nudge-selection-walk.json, real screenshots); 2346 tests green; pushed as 0a803f4. Audit: queue/audits/2026-09-03-arrow-keys-nudge.json
